correctness.rationale: Over F8=F2[X]/(X³+X+1) reconstruct D1={(x,y):x nonzero,Tr(x²y+xy+x)=0}, |D1|=24. Six linear trace-evaluation generators from (a,b) in F8² have rank 6; all 64 codewords yield ordinary enumerator 1+24z10+12z12+24z14+3z16 exactly matching primary Table 4. Every r-dimensional message space has a unique binary reduced row echelon matrix. Independently enumerate all Gaussian-binomial counts (63,651,1395,651,63,1), 2824 total, and take bitwise OR of generator-row codeword supports for each subspace. This independently reproduces every six support histogram in RESULT.md, minima (10,15,19,21,23,24) and minimizer multiplicities (24,32,144,32,24,1). Actual artifacts/verify.py and certificate.json inspected and agreed; enumeration is exhaustive within exact 6-dim message space.

originality.rationale: The code construction and ordinary enumerator for the projective minimal [24,6,10] D1 trace code are exactly prior Liao–Zhang–Zheng. The new complete SSWD and generalized hierarchy involve support intersections in 2–6 dimensional subcodes; neither prior enumerator nor projectivity/minimality fixes these. Pan et al solve other simplex-derived families; an older parameter-matching self-orthogonal [24,6,10] code has an inequivalent ordinary enumerator.
